# Breakdown adjustments

Used in [Special rules](/rules/90-special).

## Table

| Vehicle | Shift | Shift max |
|---|---|---|
| truck | -2 | — |
| armoured car | -1 | — |
| armoured recce | 0 | — |
| sp gun | -1 | 2 |
| tank | -1 | 2 |

## Notes

- Tanks and SP guns carry an individual rating between shift and shift_max on the Tank & Gun Characteristics Charts (e.g. Italian M 13/40 = 1R per the Sept 1979 errata to 21.12, E-023)
- Shift is applied cumulatively with the weather shift (SPI 21.32)
